title: Difficult to sleep
text: Difficult to sleep. I have been looking and researching a variety of mattress toppers. I wasn't thrilled with this one, difficult to sleep, hard to stay cool (menopause), and not soft. My boyfriend however loved it but I am not a fan. The only positive things to review - I was able to return it and the company was very accommodating if I wanted to exchange it through them.
